Localização ótima, apartamento espaçoso. Camas não são confortáveis, custo alto. - O apartamento é espaçoso. A localização é ótima, no centro histórico, próximo a bares, restaurantes e atrações para visitar. As camas não são confortáveis, o valor é alto para não dormir bem. Não estávamos conseguindo encontrar a entrada do prédio, pois fica num beco, poderia ser melhor explicado. Tentamos ligar para o anfitrião e não atendeu.
Der Aufenthalt war schön bei optimaler Lage der Wohnung - Fahrstuhl in Wohnung, Lage, Sauberkeit , freundliche und kompetente Abwicklung, Gäste, die sich nicht an Regeln halten( einmalig)
- Muy cómodo y conveniente

Lovely apartment in centre of the city - Location was perfect surrounded by bars and restaurants. Walking distance to everything. Apartment was very clean and had everything you need. Air conditioning was ok but upstairs bedroom was very warm
- raam badkamer kan likje verf gebruiken en deur douche kan beter , voor de rest ok
Jederzeit wieder - Super Wohnung in absoluter Top-Lage.

A Perfect Stay in Girona. - Location - nice to have the vibe of the city around us and the apartment is within striking distance of the key attractions. Spotlessly clean and everything well thought through for the customer. High standard of decor and extremely safe. We walked everywhere and had no need for a car or transport. An exceptional apartment and we fell in love with Girona. The recycling system is quite clever once you understand it and makes you think twice about your holiday garbage! It was fine for us as we are reasonably fit, but the stairs could be challenging for some. Yes, there is some city noise, but being in the heart of both the old town and the pedestrian zone outweighed the odd bit of vehicle noise in the night. We loved the apartment - a perfect 10!
- Exceptional location - really special Everything was great

- Liked the tile floors and the exposed brick. It has a funky vibe in a brilliant location and the staff were very helpful throughout. The toaster didn't work and blew a fuse but that was fixable. The bin situation was a bit confusing, and a little frustrating to have to buy staples such as salt or oil when staying for a short time.
- Muy cómodo y conveniente

Departamento en Centro histórico de Girona - La ubicación es excelente, en pleno centro histórico de Girona, y una vez dentro el departamento resultó cómodo y funcional. Las sábanas y toallas estaban en buen estado y el alojamiento contaba con todo lo necesario para una estadía corta. Sin embargo, nuestra experiencia de llegada fue muy negativa. Llegamos de noche y nos llevó más de una hora encontrar el alojamiento. El edificio no tenía una numeración visible y las indicaciones proporcionadas no fueron suficientes para identificarlo fácilmente. Además, el departamento tampoco estaba claramente identificado, lo que generó mucha incertidumbre y una sensación inicial de que la reserva podía no existir. Otro aspecto a mejorar es el proceso de check-in. Resultó excesivamente burocrático y demandó mucho tiempo durante las vacaciones. Fue necesario completar numerosos formularios en línea, realizar firmas digitales, gestionar documentación adicional y efectuar pagos de tasas a través de diferentes plataformas. Todo el proceso requiere disponer de una buena conexión a internet y dedicarle bastante tiempo, algo que puede resultar incómodo después de un viaje. La atención al huésped también dejó que desear. Todo el proceso es completamente impersonal, sin recepción ni personal que reciba a los huéspedes. Cuando intentamos comunicarnos por teléfono alrededor de las 22:00 porque no encontrábamos el alojamiento, nadie respondió. En una situación así, contar con asistencia hubiera sido fundamental. Respecto al estado general, el departamento estaba correcto, aunque el baño necesita algo de mantenimiento, especialmente la bañera. En resumen, la ubicación es muy buena y el alojamiento cumple con lo básico, pero la complejidad del check-in, la dificultad para encontrar el lugar y la falta de asistencia al huésped afectan considerablemente la experiencia general. Ya detalle todo lo que mejoraría

Una pena que con pequeños detalles, la estancia hubiera sido perfecta - Ubicación y reforma con gusto La ubicación es excelente, en pleno centro de Girona, con todo a mano y en una zona muy agradable un para recorrer la ciudad. Al estar en una calle muy transitada, hay algo de ruido por las noches, pero es algo esperable dada la localización. La reforma del apartamento está hecha con mucho gusto y el resultado es muy bonito, tanto en las habitaciones como en los baños. Sin embargo, la limpieza ha sido el gran punto negativo de nuestra estancia. En nuestra opinión, está muy por debajo de lo que se espera en un alojamiento de estas características. Encontramos telarañas en las barandillas del balcón, especialmente en las que dan a la calle principal, que claramente no se limpian desde hace mucho tiempo, así como suciedad en las ventanas exteriores. También había polvo acumulado encima de los cuadros de una de las habitaciones, un ticket de restaurante encima del armario de la segunda habitación, suciedad en rincones, cristales bastante opacos y una papelera con restos de una caja de bombilla. La sensación general era de falta de limpieza profunda y de mantenimiento. Todas estas observaciones fueron documentadas con fotografías tomadas durante nuestra estancia. Además, nos sorprendió comprobar que la cama del dormitorio principal no tenía funda de colchón. En la segunda habitación, formada por dos camas individuales unidas, una de ellas tenía funda y la otra no. Consideramos que se trata de un aspecto básico de higiene que debería estar garantizado en cualquier alojamiento. Los productos de limpieza disponibles eran correctos, pero claramente insuficientes para varios días. Se indica que se proporcionan para dos días y que, si se necesita más, hay que comprarlos. Lo entendemos, pero en una estancia de cuatro días resultaría lógico disponer, por ejemplo, de cuatro cápsulas para el lavavajillas en lugar de dos. La fregona estaba en muy mal estado y la mopa no tenía recambios, lo que dificulta mantener el apartamento en condiciones adecuadas durante la estancia.

- Upon arrival, we found the fans covered in dust, and the sheets in the main bedroom had both blood stains and hair on them. As a result, we slept in the front bedroom on the first night. Unfortunately, that bed was extremely firm and uncomfortable. I messaged the host at 9:30 a.m., and while a very kind staff member came around 5:00 p.m. to clean and replace all of the bedding, the overall cleanliness of the apartment remained below expectations. The apartment felt quite dusty throughout our stay, and much of the furniture in the main living area was also uncomfortable. The apartment was stocked with basic dishes, cookware, and silverware, but otherwise provided only the bare minimum. There were no essentials such as salt, pepper, olive oil, or coffee. The balcony off the main bedroom is not private as shown and overlooks the below neighbors pool. Additionally, there are several flights of stairs to get in/out of the apt. I would not recommend for families with small children.

- Pros: The location is excellent, and it was spacious for a family of four. The TV gave us access to World Cup games. 2 of the 3 nights were quiet, although on the fourth there was street noise audible until late in the night. Cons: The apartment is rundown overall. I was quite surprised by the positive reviews, perhaps it has become run down over time. There was peeling paint and damaged moulding. There is mold in the shower and in the kitchen area closets—the smell is quite strong when you open those cabinets. The fridge was slightly open when we arrived and took hours to cool down again. The balconies are nice but the shutters don’t open all the way. We were given towels with stains on them, and the beds were uncomfortable. It took 24 hrs to get enough towels for all of us, although we had registered all of our guests. We have stayed in 50+ midrange airBnBs across multiple countries and this was honestly one of the worst stays. We would not stay here—or with Bravissimo—again.

- The flat is very well located right in the centre of town. Bravissimo are an excellent company to work with, with clear and easy communications using their app. It is a good flat and I would have given it 4/5 overall as it's a good flat but you pay a good amount for it. The reason for giving 3/5 is that on our last night we were woken at 4am by other nearby guests coming back drunk and causing a huge amount of noise and we were unable to get to sleep again as the noise carried on for 2 hours. This is absolutely not Bravissimo's problem, but I just flag it for future consideration for other guests. One of the benefits of city centre flats like these are proximity and ease of access. A downside is flat density which is easily disruptive to other guests when some behave poorly, as happened on our stay. I hope anyone visiting in the future does not experience disturbance like this as the flat and Bravissimo are both very good to stay with. But I think it's fair to review honestly.

- Beautiful and cozy apartment right in the middle of Girona's old town, on a charming little square in the Barri Vell. The building itself is gorgeous, a beautifully restored 16th-century building, full of character. We used it as a base for a 3-night stay and rented a car to drive out to nearby towns in Catalunya, which worked out well even though parking isn't allowed inside the old town itself, we just parked outside before checking in. Check-in was smooth and easy, and communication with the host was great throughout the stay, quick responses and very helpful. The apartment itself is fully renovated, comfortable, and has everything you need. A great spot for exploring both Girona and the surrounding area.

- Great apartment and location - very central in the Barri Vell and walking distance to plenty of restaurants and sites (Cathedral, river bridges, medieval walls, Cinema Museum, etc). It's a top-floor walkup but not uncommon in Europe and pretty easy even with suitcases. The flat itself was immaculate and very charming, with lovely windows overlooking the Placa del Vi, and a spacious, well-equipped kitchen and living area. The bedrooms are great with plenty of closet space, though worth noting that this is really a large studio with dividers, so there's no real privacy between bedrooms (perfect for me, as I was with my two young kids anyway, but not for everyone). Only minor inconvenience was that little effort made to accommodate a slightly earlier check-in despite repeated inquiries (normal check-in at 4pm) - the door code automatically appears at that time.

- Apartmán se nachází v klidné uličce, přitom velmi blízko centra města. Vyhovovala nám také dobrá dostupnost vlakového/autobusového nádraží, které je vzdálené přibližně 8–10 minut chůze, protože jsme každý den vyráželi na výlety. Apartmán byl čistý, udržovaný a celkově dobře vybavený. Upozornil bych pouze na tři drobné technické nedostatky. Stolek u pohovky byl velmi vratký, takže jsme na něj raději nic nepokládali, aby se nesložil jako domeček z karet. Také televize byla zavěšená na konstrukci, která se poměrně nebezpečně pohybovala, proto jsme s ní raději vůbec nemanipulovali. Posledním nedostatkem byla dvířka pod kuchyňským dřezem, která nedržela pevně na pantech a bylo nutné je otevírat opatrně. Jedná se však o běžné provozní záležitosti, které lze snadno odstranit a pravděpodobně souvisejí s vysokou vytížeností apartmánu. Celkově jsme byli s pobytem spokojeni a v budoucnu bychom se sem rádi znovu vrátili.

Centrally located apartment but disappointed with a lot of its features. - They had a great check in system via the Bravissimo App which made it very convenient for us. Location was good and central. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby There are a few things we did'nt like: 1. First was although the description indicates there is AIRCONDITIONING, there was only one AC and it was located in the family hall entrance. The rooms only had CEILING FANS. We visited during the summer and so the Rooms got pretty unpleasant during the day, even at night time. We had to keep our bedroom doors open so that the cold from the AC would filter to our rooms. I pity our companion whose room was at the very end of the hallway because his room was always hot. 2. There was no Elevator and the unit is located on the 3rd Floor. Although there was no mention of this in the property description, I think it should be indicated as the unit is on the top most floor. Let the potential clients decide if its worth it or not, especially if somebody in the group has some type of disability. We had a challenging time bringing our luggages up when we checked in and also bringing them down when we checked out. We visited Girona to cycle and we had to carry our bikes up 3 flights of stairs everytime we finished our ride. What made it worst was the stairs were very narrow and it can be quite dangerous to traverse up and down when bringing down your bike. 3. I informed the person handling the unit via the app that there was a light in one of the rooms that was not working. In fact, there were several also in the hallway that were inop. They said they will send someone to replace it but no one ever came. Also, the property details indicated there was a blow dryer, but non was to be found.

The building does not get much light from the outside because it doesn't have windows (except the bedroom) but this was not a problem for us since it was 35 degrees outside. It was cool inside the flat all the time, even without the aircon, so it is definitely a great choice for the summer. Being in the medieval town was also quite special. The host was super attentive and we could connect via WhatsApp if we had questions. Also the building felt quite safe. All was great, highly recommended.
- There are no comments available for this review

- Pros: The location is excellent, and it was spacious for a family of four. The TV gave us access to World Cup games. 2 of the 3 nights were quiet, although on the fourth there was street noise audible until late in the night. Cons: The apartment is rundown overall. I was quite surprised by the positive reviews, perhaps it has become run down over time. There was peeling paint and damaged moulding. There is mold in the shower and in the kitchen area closets—the smell is quite strong when you open those cabinets. The fridge was slightly open when we arrived and took hours to cool down again. The balconies are nice but the shutters don’t open all the way. We were given towels with stains on them, and the beds were uncomfortable. It took 24 hrs to get enough towels for all of us, although we had registered all of our guests. We have stayed in 50+ midrange airBnBs across multiple countries and this was honestly one of the worst stays. We would not stay here—or with Bravissimo—again.

A very pleasant stay !! - Roomy, clean , quiet ,central location ,good value adequate cups, glasses etc. Good WiFi , Tv washing machine Good Supermarket across the road, excellent coffee shops within 10 metres Did get into property early by 2.30 pm On third floor with narrow stairs, so difficult getting bike boxes / bikes up and down. Air con only in entrance area, but there was ceiling fans in all other rooms . Very warm when we were there.
Agrafable - La ubicacion El dormitorio es pequeño, apenas hay espacio para las dos camas. El baño es tambien pequeño.
Experiencia muy buena en un apartamento más que correcto - Muy acorde a lo descrito, en perfecto estado y con una localización inmejorable

- Bravissimo were outstanding hosts- they allowed us to be able to check in early as the apartment was available. Replied to messages almost instantly. We had an issue with air conditioning and they came out to try and fix it straight away. They arranged a taxi for us to the airport which was cheaper than the one we chose on arrival. The location is perfect and Girona is stunning. Honestly amazing customer service and would recommend highly to future guests. Thank you for a lovely stay.

- La mia impressione è che Bravissimo non sia in linea con lo spirito di Airbnb. Prima mi hanno chiesto una cauzione e, solo dopo mie richieste di chiarimento, si sono resi conto che i membri di Airbnb non la devono versare. Ti fanno registrare su una piattaforma parallela che serve anche per il check in, invece di usare quella di Airbnb. Non sanno dirti se puoi anticipare l'orario del checkin fino al giorno dell'arrivo perchè è una gestione di tipo alberghiero. Tuttavia, non ha i vantaggi di un hotel: in casa, c'è una vecchia macchinetta del caffè ma non ti lasciano la capsule, che difficilmente acquisti per pochi giorni di soggiorno; se hai un problema con la casa, chi ti scrive non la conosce e l'unica soluzione che riesce a proporti è far venire dei tecnici. In sintesi, lo sconsiglio.
- Tres bon séjour passé a Girona dans ce logement équipé d'une climatisation bien appréciable

- Absolutely amazing views of the old town in Girona. Loved our riverside windows and the balcony overlooking the streets near the cathedral. The staircase was very tricky with bike as described so something to bear in mind. However the flat was absolutely lovely and would most definitely come to stay again/for longer! Thanks for hosting our stay in Girona

- The flat is very well located right in the centre of town. Bravissimo are an excellent company to work with, with clear and easy communications using their app. It is a good flat and I would have given it 4/5 overall as it's a good flat but you pay a good amount for it. The reason for giving 3/5 is that on our last night we were woken at 4am by other nearby guests coming back drunk and causing a huge amount of noise and we were unable to get to sleep again as the noise carried on for 2 hours. This is absolutely not Bravissimo's problem, but I just flag it for future consideration for other guests. One of the benefits of city centre flats like these are proximity and ease of access. A downside is flat density which is easily disruptive to other guests when some behave poorly, as happened on our stay. I hope anyone visiting in the future does not experience disturbance like this as the flat and Bravissimo are both very good to stay with. But I think it's fair to review honestly.

- Great location, 4 bedrooms. Bravissimo team very helpful with an early check in. Photos slightly overplay the usable space, quality of fixtures, fittings and furniture. Courtyard is not quite as it seems- surrounded by high walls and quite a barren place to spend time. That said our biggest challenge was staying during 30 degree plus heat- large south facing windows with 4 small fans and No AC … it gets pretty hot!

- No es un piso para ir en verano. Mucho calor y ruido de la calle principal. Solo hay aire acondicionado en el salon y no llega a las habitaciones. El resto de amenities muy bien: cocina completa, piso reformado bastante nuevo, baños bien. No hay ascensor. Sistema de acceso muy cómodo, sin necesidad de llave. La verdad que nos sorprendió mucho y fue muy practico -con un link se gestionaba todo desde el movil. Huésped muy atento. Fueron estrictos con la hora de check out pero nos dejaron dejar las maletas en sus oficinas durante medio dia del domingo (gracias!)

- Our stay for a friends holiday was great - well-located near the train and bus station for arrivals/departures and a day trip to the beach (Tossa del Mar) and only a stones throw away from high restaurants with great atmosphere, very easy to get around by foot. The apartment was clean and good air conditioning in the heat - we really enjoyed breakfasts on the patio in the morning. Bravissimo were proactive in communications and very responsive. Would highly recommend a stay here!
- Sehr gut gelegen und ruhig. Haben es genossen.

- Great apartment and location - very central in the Barri Vell and walking distance to plenty of restaurants and sites (Cathedral, river bridges, medieval walls, Cinema Museum, etc). It's a top-floor walkup but not uncommon in Europe and pretty easy even with suitcases. The flat itself was immaculate and very charming, with lovely windows overlooking the Placa del Vi, and a spacious, well-equipped kitchen and living area. The bedrooms are great with plenty of closet space, though worth noting that this is really a large studio with dividers, so there's no real privacy between bedrooms (perfect for me, as I was with my two young kids anyway, but not for everyone). Only minor inconvenience was that little effort made to accommodate a slightly earlier check-in despite repeated inquiries (normal check-in at 4pm) - the door code automatically appears at that time.

The apartment is clean, modern, very comfortable and the host is kind , helpful and always responsive. We will definitely stay here when we come back to Girona!
- Séjour parfait, idéalement situé pour visiter cette magnifique ville. Logement très fonctionnel.

- The apartment is very centrally located just a few steps away from Placa Catalunya and right outside of Girona's Old Town. It is one flight up from street level via stairs. The inside of the apartment is exactly as described: 2 single beds pushed together making a king size bed and facing the living area with 2 chairs and a nice-sized smart TV. The kitchen is spacious with an induction range, full sized fridge, nespresso machine, electric kettle, and toaster which suited our needs. The bathroom has a modern shower, sink, and toilet. The air conditioner worked well, which was extremely appreciated during the heatwave. The washing machine did not have a dryer function, but a drying rack is provided and dried our clothes overnight. The Bravissimo staff were also very pleasant and responsive. We would stay with them again.
- Great appartment, location is perfect and good value. Really quick to respond and very helpful. Thank you!
Amazing weekend in an amazing city - Location was amazing - so close to the old town. Very clean and tidy. Two great bathrooms. Very well appointed flat.

list.txt: - This flat is magnificent. The location is perfect, and it's an oasis of (literal) chill and calm in beautiful Girona. It's incredibly high-specced and stylish and very spacious. We loved everything about it.

Grande, nuevo y espacioso. - Bien ubicado pegado al centro. Todo nuevo. Camas cómodas y nada ruidoso. Faltaría en la cocina unos mínimos de azúcar o sal ya que no hay nada y también alguna percha en los baños. El parking que recomienda es muy caro.

- This Airbnb was in a fantastic location—super walkable. Free parking was available easily during the summer, and we didn’t hear the railroad at all. The AC in the unit is only in the living room, so we had to keep fans set up in the bedroom doors to move some cooler air to the bedrooms. The shower was good, but the bathroom window shade did not go down so we had to hang a towel for privacy. The beds were comfortable, but pillows were thin. The couch was surprisingly dingy. Overall a fine stay, but we could feel it was run by a business as opposed to an individual. It could be an amazing space with some care, but for now it is very well located and basic. They also had us sign a separate lease before check in with more rules then were in the listing. All that said, we felt it was a good value and could be the right choice for many people.

- Moc hezký byt. Přímo v centru města. Kousek od podzemních garáží. Dobře vybavený. Nikdo nás nerušil. Naše 3 male děti ocenily velký centrální prostor, trocha gymnastiky :) Problém je (a o tom jsme předem věděli od pronajimatelu), že není v domě výtah. Byt je v posledním patře. Pokud máte 4 veliký kufry, tak už nemusíte chodit ten den do posilovny :)
Cerca del casco - Está a 10 min de la estación y en el caso historico La cama, no es matrimonial, son 2 individuales y las juntan

- This apartment was perfect. I am originally from Girona and I can tell you that the location is just perfect. It is a couple of blocks from the old town, a nice and easy walk down the street. There are many bakeries and places to eat within a block, including grocery stores and little convenient markets that remain open very late at night. It is two blocks from the train station, which is very convenient if you are arriving/departing to/from Girona by train. The apartment is cozy and bright, plenty of sunshine and light, with amazing views all around. You can see the old town and the cathedral from one of the windows which it is a plus. The bedrooms are cozy and the beds are very comfortable. The kitchen is very well equipped but there is no dishwasher, which it was perfectly fine for us but it is good to know. Overall, I would give it a 10! We will repeat!

- Nous avons réservé ce logement pour passer une semaine à Gérone avec un bébé et visiter les alentours. L’appartement était parfait pour cela : bien placé avec le quartier historique à deux pas et suffisamment confortable pour y passer une part importante de nos journées. Très pratique de disposer d’un lave linge.

- Para mi propósito de viaje (estadía académica) fue excelente. Ubicación genial, perfecto para una persona si es larga estancia, mercados cerca, paradas de bus cerca, restaurantes cerca, estación de tren y buses cerca. La comunicación con Bravissimo fue permanente y siempre atendieron oportunamente mis preguntas. Es pequeño tal cual como se muestra en fotos y aún así tiene todo lo que se necesita. Excelente!!!

This was fine for us as we have our own. Apartment is on the second floor but has a good lift and the host allowed us to take our bikes into the apartment as long as we were careful. Being able to do this was fantastic for us as we could enjoy Girona knowing they were secure. All in all a great stay.

- Très belle maison idéalement située à Gérone, en plein mois d’août ! L’emplacement est vraiment magnifique, juste à côté de la chapelle et de la vieille ville. Un grand parking gratuit se trouve à deux pas, ce qui est un vrai plus. La maison est très bien aménagée, avec tout le nécessaire sur place : vaisselle, ustensiles et équipements. Les draps sont également fournis pour tout le monde, et l’accès à la maison est très pratique. Quelques petits points à savoir : il n’y a qu’une seule climatisation, située dans la chambre principale. Elle peut être un peu bruyante et rafraîchit également l’espace avec le canapé situé juste en dessous au premier étage. La deuxième chambre, avec les lits superposés, est un peu plus étroite et ne dispose pas de climatisation, mais un ventilateur est disponible sur place. Dans l’ensemble, c’est une maison que je recommande particulièrement pour 5 personnes, surtout pour profiter de Gérone à pied grâce à son emplacement exceptionnel. Je recommande

They gave us 1 washing machine tablet and 1 tiny sachet of dish soap. I asked for more and they said no. So we had to buy whole packs of these things. Stupid stinginess that just leaves a bad taste. We also had trouble getting inside because their door system did not work. They did not come to resolve the matter in person (the office is 5 minutes walk) but just kept sending us pointless messages until eventually they had to give us the proper code. For the money I expect much better.

Příjemné ubytovanie v centre Girony, priestorne, zariadene i na varenie, vhodne pre 4 clenu rodinu, krásny vyhlad na kat - Výhodná poloha, uprostřed historického centra města, dostupné chodzou, 20 min. chodze na autobusovú a vlakovú stanicu, výťah v budově, plne zariadený byt, chladnička, práčka, žehlička, vešiak na prádlo, hrnce v kuchyni. Osušky, fén v kúpelni. 2 toalety sprchový kut, komunikácia cez what up ohadne kľúčov, video návod ako sa dostať dnu. Klimatizácia v každej miestnosti veľký bonus zvlášť v létě.veľa úložných priestorov. Výhľad na katedrálu. Pleseň v sprchovacom kúte, chýbajúce vešiačiky na osušky v kúpelni a wc, už opotřebovaný nábytok na niektorých miestach, niektoré stěny ušpiněné odnávštevníkov. Práčku před použitím som musela umyť, bola vnútri špína prach. Niektoré riady boli v poličke medzi čistým ale neboli umyté. Chýbal pripravok na umytie riadu v ruke, tak sme ho dokúpili a nechali pre ostatných. Boli iba kapsle do umývačky riadu. Celkovo by som přidala na úklide. Od návštěvníkov sa požaduje odvoz odpadkov a orientácia v systéme- čo je dosť nepraktické keď tam prídete na pár dní a neovládáte jazyk a nemáte názorně uvedené kde odpadky zanechať . v kuchyni by som uvítala soľ, cukor, olej - pokiaľ si chcete uvariť je to nepraktické bez týchto základných věcí, zvýšilo by to komfort návštěvníkom. Nedostatečná zvuková izolácia, 2 x sme boli zobudení nadránom 4-5 hodina, keď iní návštěvníci přišli opití, robili veľký hluk, počuli sme celú koverzáciu od slova do slova…

Great, modern apartment in a perfect location, but let down slightly by thin walls. - The apartment is spacious, modernly furnished, and features an excellent air conditioning system and a great shower. There are also plenty of power sockets throughout, which was very convenient. Check-in was seamless; we received the entry codes on the day of arrival, and physical keys were provided inside. The location is fantastic, offering easy access to the city center and plenty of nearby restaurants. The soundproofing is quite poor; we could hear every movement (like chairs scratching from the apartment above, or doors closing throughout the building). Finding the entrance was also a bit confusing at first; it would help to mention that it is the door located in the bright red building. Additionally, Girona’s waste disposal system is quite complicated for newcomers; it would be great if the hosts provided an alternative solution or simpler instructions for guests staying just 2–3 days. Lastly, having a few basic kitchen essentials like salt and sugar would be a wonderful touch.

- This apartment has a great layout and an amazing location, but unfortunately, there were several issues that affected our stay. Most concerning was the bathroom: the shower had visibly moldy, dirty grout, along with buildup in several other areas. The host offered to send someone over, but since we were only staying for a couple of nights and addressing the issue properly would have been disruptive and time-consuming, we declined. Given the condition of the shower, I would have appreciated some form of partial refund, but none was offered. The apartment also did not include basic kitchen supplies such as dish soap or a sponge, so we had to purchase those ourselves. There was a washing machine but no dryer, which made it impractical to use during such a short stay. The location and layout were definite positives, but the bathroom cleanliness and missing basics kept this from being the stay we had hoped for.

A few practical notes for future guests: indoor space for storing 5 bikes is quite tight/limited, so you'll need to pack them in carefully. It might be fine if bedroom doors were left open at night, but that wasn’t something that worked for us. We were able to solve it by using the sofabed in the living room as a second bedroom instead, but that decreased the living space. - 100% recommend Bravissimo to stay with. They were contactable at all times and helped us even before we arrived in Girona. Spoke and messaged perfect English. We were one of the first to trial a new locking system which we were sceptical of but it allowed every party member to access the apartment through their phones which was very easy to use and worked well. We were provided physical keys also. The apartment was clean and presentable. We had an issue with hot water in the shower on one of the days but Bravissimo sorted it there and then. - This was a really spacious, modern and comfortable apartment despite being in a historic building. Our favorite spot was the balcony overlooking a lovely block which is mostly pedestrian. Nice showers and beds. You will need to bring or buy (plenty of mercados nearby) coffee supplies for the Nespresso machine. It is noted in the listing, but I must emphasize that you will need to park in the main town area and the parking lots are 30-40 euro a day. It is a good 10 minute walk (carrying your luggage) to the apartment. There are 2 flights of stairs to the flat which are very old and have a lot of loose bricks and mortar, so it is a bit challenging with luggage. But once settled in, we loved being able to walk all over this charming medieval town with so much history but also excellent local shops and restaurants. Occasionally mid day, we had to dodge large groups of tourists, but that is part of what you get with such a popular spot. Overall we were quite happy with this place!

Que había poco menaje de cocina y había platos y sartenes sucias. También nos fijamos en que las sábanas aunque se notaban que habían pasado por lavadora, tenían manchas antiguas. Había mucho ruido de fuera, sobretodo cuando pasaban palets con ruedas de los negocios, pero es que está en pleno centro. Difícil acceso para tirar la basura solo en días concretos, pero eso es en toda Girona por el sistema que tienen. Cuando luego el resto de papeleras están llenas.

- Liked the location more than I expected to. Overall liked the place but wasn’t impressed with customer service. We were 4 guys staying for a week on a cycling trip. One of the showers leaks really bad so we had to mop every day and use towels to prevent water from draining into the bedroom. I asked for more laundry pods and toilet paper and they said I needed to buy it. I didn’t initially mention or complain about the shower because I didn’t feel like I should have to justify that simple request for a 7 day stay

- Appartement très spacieux et idéalement situé dans le centre historique. Conforme aux photos. Un plaisir en arrivant. Pas de chance sur une partie de notre séjour car l'appartement est très mal isolé et nous avons eu des voisins très bruyants une partie de la nuit. Les principaux défauts sont le manque de rideaux occultants aux fenêtres, et la qualité de literie qui nécessiterait d'être changée car les matelas sont très durs. Autrement, pour visiter le vieux Gérone à pied, se restaurer, acheter, l'emplacement est idéal.

- Excellent location and very clean. Air conditioning very good. However, problems with noise from other apartments due to thin walls. Guests need to have smart phones because access is via the host's web app and there are no conventional keys.

- Appartement très spacieux et idéalement situé dans le centre historique. Conforme aux photos. Un plaisir en arrivant. Pas de chance sur une partie de notre séjour car l'appartement est très mal isolé et nous avons eu des voisins très bruyants une partie de la nuit. Les principaux défauts sont le manque de rideaux occultants aux fenêtres, et la qualité de literie qui nécessiterait d'être changée car les matelas sont très durs. Autrement, pour visiter le vieux Gérone à pied, se restaurer, acheter, l'emplacement est idéal.

- Great location. Middle of old town with a coffee shop on the first floor of the building. Plenty of shopping and good restaurants nearby. Apartment could use a little more basics like salt and pepper or oil for the kitchen to cook with. more than just body soap for the shower would have been nice. Shampoo can’t be that expensive to provide. No major complaints. If you’re looking for a place in old town and don’t have 5 star hotel expectations, I would highly suggest this rental.

- I want to be fair, but our stay with Bravissimo was disappointing. The apartment is pretty, with vaulted ceilings and interesting features, though very minimal in amenities and furnishings, which was fine since we weren’t there much. Cleanliness was a problem. There was hair on the shower walls, and the comforter in the closet was covered in stains. The bed only had a thin sheet, so we needed the comforter, but it felt unsanitary. Pre-arrival communication was thorough. Parking was another story. We paid the hosts directly to validate our garage ticket, and we were assured it would work. At 5:30 am, it didn’t, and I was stuck trying to get out of the garage while my family worried about missing our flight. It was extremely stressful. When the hosts finally responded, they showed no sympathy and told me to take it up with the garage. As a host myself, I would have done everything possible to help a guest in that situation. I won’t book with them again when I return to Girona.

- We enjoyed our stay at the apartment. It was modern and stylish. It was in the heart of the old town which was beautiful and convenient. We found it very loud at night with the windows open, and the apartment lacked a few useful things like hooks for towels/coats, a lamp in the second bedroom and only had one set of keys which was a little annoying for three adults in the apartment. We loved our stay in Girona- thank you
- There are no comments available for this review

- The location of this home is hard to beat. Just steps out of the front door are wonderful restaurants, coffee shops (Velodrome bike shop), and the grocery store is just around the corner. The house does have an elevator which will hold one bike at a time but worth the wait. The staircase to the fourth floor is very narrow, so the lift was quite useful. Be prepared that this rental doesn't offer any of the typical hospitality extras you'd find in most rentals. They do not provide shampoo/ conditioner, coffee, and the kitchen is very poorly stocked if you're trying to cook while there. No salt, pepper, oil, etc. The AC worked really well and was probably worth the whole stay.

- The location could not be reached by car or bus and one has to walk probably 1/2 mile up hill and stairs to get to apartment. There is an elevator that ends up near the apartment, which we had not informed about until we had already hiked with our luggage to the apartment. The area was very quiet and peaceful, and the city wall was directly behind us. The elevator is in use from 8am to 8pm and takes you into the heart of the old city. Being uniformef about the difficulty reaching and the availability of the elevator.
- Séjour parfait, idéalement situé pour visiter cette magnifique ville. Logement très fonctionnel.
Estudio pequeñito, bien ubicado pero muy ruidoso. - La cama muy cómoda. Súper súper ruidoso. El baño pequeñito.

- The apartment is very centrally located just a few steps away from Placa Catalunya and right outside of Girona's Old Town. It is one flight up from street level via stairs. The inside of the apartment is exactly as described: 2 single beds pushed together making a king size bed and facing the living area with 2 chairs and a nice-sized smart TV. The kitchen is spacious with an induction range, full sized fridge, nespresso machine, electric kettle, and toaster which suited our needs. The bathroom has a modern shower, sink, and toilet. The air conditioner worked well, which was extremely appreciated during the heatwave. The washing machine did not have a dryer function, but a drying rack is provided and dried our clothes overnight. The Bravissimo staff were also very pleasant and responsive. We would stay with them again.
- Logement idéalement situé, parking gratuite à proximité. Photos de l’annonce identique à la réalité. Appartement confortable et propre.
- Sobre todo destacar la localizacion, ¡inmejorable!. Todo ha ido genial.

Goed gelegen appartement - De vriendelijke respons van het personeel. De ligging van het appartement. Het appartement was wat krapjes als de bedbank was uitgeklapt. Het zou fijn zijn als er een paar basisbenodigdheden: zout, peper, olie, misschien wat koffie en thee aanwezig zouden zijn in het appartement. Verder was alles prima!
- Muy contentos en general con todo.
